items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And then I stayed in California and Al Morgan came back to join me in California because I organized a band out there.

ctx.x: But anyway, we went to California. This is the first time, I think, Cab had gone to California. That's when I stayed out in California. But we went out there and played up and down the coast, in Frank Sebastian's Cotton Club, then we made a picture with Al Jolson, "The Singing Kid."
And then I stayed in California and Al Morgan came back to join me in California because I organized a band out there.
